name: styles
docs: Import it from your global stylesheet right after Tailwind, so Tailwind compiles the utilities Plex UI components use: `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "./plexui.css";` in app/globals.css. Do not import it from JavaScript on its own. With a src/app directory, change the @source path to ../../node_modules/@plexui/ui. See https://plexui.com/docs/installation for the layer order.
